candidate.title: CellFluxRL: Biologically-Constrained Virtual Cell Modeling via Reinforcement Learning
candidate.abstract: Building virtual cells with generative models to simulate cellular behavior in silico is emerging as a promising paradigm for accelerating drug discovery. However, prior image-based generative approaches can produce implausible cell images that violate basic physical and biological constraints. To address this, we propose to post-train virtual cell models with reinforcement learning (RL), leveraging biologically meaningful evaluators as reward functions. We design seven rewards spanning three categories-biological function, structural validity, and morphological correctness-and optimize the state-of-the-art CellFlux model to yield CellFluxRL. CellFluxRL consistently improves over CellFlux across all rewards, with further performance boosts from test-time scaling. Overall, our results present a virtual cell modeling framework that enforces physically-based constraints through RL, advancing beyond "visually realistic" generations towards "biologically meaningful" ones.
candidate.authors: Dongxia Wu, Shiye Su, Yuhui Zhang, Elaine Sui, Emma Lundberg, Emily B. Fox, Serena Yeung-Levy

panel.reason: RL后训练虚拟细胞模型，含生物约束奖励，契合方向
RL后训练虚拟细胞模型，含生物约束奖励，契合方向。

extraction.method: 强化学习后训练CellFlux，七类生物奖励约束
extraction.data: 图像型细胞筛选数据（CellFlux训练数据）
extraction.results: CellFluxRL在所有奖励上持续优于CellFlux，测试时扩展进一步提升性能
extraction.limitations: 奖励为加权线性组合，权重设计依赖人工；仅验证于CellFlux一种生成框架
extraction.summary: 针对图像虚拟细胞生成违反物理与生物约束的问题，提出用强化学习后训练CellFlux。设计生物功能、结构有效性与形态正确性三类共七个奖励，通过采样-优化交替提升高奖励样本似然。CellFluxRL在所有奖励上优于基线，测试时扩展进一步增益，实现从视觉逼真到生物学有意义的生成。
